results.title: Universal's 'Jurassic World: Dominion' becomes most expensive film ever at $658.8M, surpassing Disney's 'Star Wars: The Force Awakens | Dealroom.co
excerpts: ● Jun 2026 NBCUniversal has overtaken Disney as the maker of Hollywood's most expensive film, according to recently filed financial statements. Universal Pictures spent $658.8 million producing 2022's "Jurassic World: Dominion", surpassing Disney's 2015 "Star Wars: The Force Awakens" which cost $638.9 million. Filmed during the pandemic in 2020, Dominion's costs ballooned due to safety protocols, months of delays and maintaining production readiness. The cast quarantined for five months at the luxury Langley Hotel in the UK, where rooms cost over $600 nightly. The production benefited from the UK's Audio-Visual Expenditure Credit, receiving a $127.8 million reimbursement, bringing Universal's net outlay to $531 million.
